correctness.rationale: Explicit pair-sum fibers reconstruct convolution exactly. In odd degrees the max 3-2/q follows from triangle and power mean with full equality. In even degrees the only double fibers are inverse-subfield packets; the orbitwise inequalities reduce to an elementary one-variable concave quadratic, with boundary 1/13 and exact nonnegative factorization 3(a-b)^2(a^2+2ab+5b^2). Equality conditions and counts are derived, not extrapolated. The package checker exact-tests F2 to F64.

value.rationale: A canonical nonlinear Fourier extension graph has an exact sharp complex-weighted L2-to-L4 norm and full optimizer census across all binary finite fields. Odd/even extension parity causes a qualitative transition between full-support sign vectors and F4-subfield four-point packets. Neither unweighted differential counts nor the already-known existence of F4 subspace zero sums provides these sharp weighted consequences.
